title: Joint Pricing and Innovation Control in Regulated Recycling-Rate Diffusion
summary: We introduce a regulated stochastic diffusion model for the recycling rate and formulate a joint control problem over production and process innovation via the dynamics of recycling investment and product pricing. The resulting stochastic control problem captures the system manager's trade-off between product-price decisions and investment expenditures under an infinite-horizon discounted cost structure.
